subject: I want the legend bar to spread out a little as it is too much clustered

messages.author: 7d87e40ca158a45f
messages.subject: I want the legend bar to spread out a little as it is too much clustered
parts:
Dear All
I used the following code
p <- ggplot(data=w, aes(x=Year, y=Yield, fill = Yield))+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
p + facet_grid(Treatment ~ Centre) + theme(legend.position="bottom") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + ggtitle("Comparative Performance of Treatments") +
xlab("Performance over the Time Period") + ylab("Yield(Kg/Ha")
and got a nice ggplot2 chart, I will be happy if I can spread the legend bar (with legend labels at 45 degree rotation, thanks Dr.D.K.Samuel, IIHR, Bangalore, India

messages.subject: Re: I want the legend bar to spread out a little as it is too much clustered
parts:
I solved the problem playing with

 guide_legend-Keywidth-Keyheight) as a bonus I also got a continuous color scheme is being shown as discrete (suits me fine as I am showing disease incidence)

Thanks for all help, Samuel
p <- ggplot(data=w, aes(x=Year, y=Yield, fill = Yield))+ geom_bar(stat="identity")

p + facet_grid(Treatment ~ Centre) + theme(legend.position="bottom") + scale_fill_continuous(low="green", high="red", limits=c(350,650)) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + ggtitle("Comparative Performance of Treatments") +

xlab("Performance over the Time Period") + ylab("Yield(Kg/Ha") + theme(legend.text = element_text(colour = 'blue', angle = 45, size = 10, hjust = 3, vjust = 3, face = 'bold'))+ guides(fill = guide_legend(keywidth = 6, keyheight = 2))
